metadata.title: Energy Market Operations Platform Deployment Channels
metadata.description: Product bricks are deployed to the supplier back-office web app, the white-label customer portal and app, the portfolio and trading workspace, the BRP operations dashboard with 15-minute financial insight, the Iberian (Nemon Trade Energy) back office, the open REST API and certified connectors (EDSN/C-AR/MMC-Hub, TenneT and GTS nominations, ETPA, OMIE/REE/SIPS, ERP and accounting, payment and SEPA, smart-meter and telemetry, price and weather feeds), the billing, forecasting, steering and market-message automation runtime including the guaranteed intraday cycle, and the internal BRP-as-a-Service operations desk, tenant administration and migration back office. All runtimes are hosted in the European Union with EU data residency for Dutch, Iberian, Belgian, German and UK tenants. Each deployed brick records the products that use it.

channels.description: Browser workspaces for supplier staff, end customers, portfolio desks, BRP operators and Iberian suppliers, one sub-channel per web application; all hosted in EU data centres with EU data residency for Dutch, Iberian, Belgian, German and UK tenants.

Operations workspace for a supplier's proposition, onboarding, contract, billing, payment, customer-service and market-communication staff; one multi-tenant application with brand isolation per supplier and per label.
